subject.title: fix(agents): thinking-enabled Anthropic sessions fail with "Invalid signature" after tool loops

question: Should OpenClaw make current-turn-only signed-thinking replay the default for all thinking-enabled native Anthropic sessions?
rationale: Anthropic permits prior-turn omission, but retained thinking can contribute context and prompt-cache continuity; selecting availability over that continuity is a product and provider-policy choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Adopt current-turn replay
options.body: Land the symmetric omission policy and accept reduced completed-turn reasoning and cache continuity to prevent permanent session failures.

options.title: Preserve historical thinking
options.body: Retain completed-turn replay and require a narrower provenance-validation or rejection-recovery design before landing.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers define a different canonical Anthropic replay contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt current-turn replay
recommendation.body: Land the symmetric omission policy and accept reduced completed-turn reasoning and cache continuity to prevent permanent session failures.
